assumptions: the holder pointer in rsi is readable and writable for at least 0x1798 bytes; behaviour on a shorter holder is not pinned
the flag bytes are written by other threads; this packet pins the routine's own control flow, not the timing of those writes
the lock-shaped callees 0x606ca40 and 0x60d52f0 behave as lock and unlock of the H+0x700 slot; their internals are not pinned here
the chain walk assumes a finite chain; cyclic input loops forever in the binary as in the model

chain_walk.head: [H+0x1790]
chain_walk.no_visited_set: a cyclic chain would loop forever in the binary; the model reproduces the walk step for step
rules: on kind > 2, step via +0x10 and resume
on null +0x18, back up to the node last stepped from via +0x10
end at a node that is not the sentinel with kind <= 3, building the temp with 0x5f22020(rsp, H+0x1748, 3, node+0x28)
throw out_of_range when backing up to the sentinel, when the end node kind > 3, or when the head is null
